fusions.name: Slow Tow
fusions.desc: Casts a trailing link at the first enemy it meets that deals 4 damage, with a 40% chance to leave it [Enervated] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Ebb Pull
fusions.desc: Draws a sweep of links through a cone ahead of you that deals 10 damage to everything within 4 tiles and knocks it back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Slack Water
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Easing Tide
fusions.desc: Each time a condition on you expires, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
